presets.label: Reporter's Current Open Issues
presets.jql: reporter = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

presets.label: My Current Open Issues
presets.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY priority DESC, updated DESC

presets.label: My Issues From the Past Year (All)
presets.jql: (statusCategory IN ("To Do", "In Progress") or (statusCategory = "Done" and resolved >= -52w)) and assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY status DESC, created DESC
